values.description: Live Azure App Service URL. Change this to http://localhost:5001 for local development.
JWT token for a logged-in customer. Auto-filled by the 'Verify OTP' request test script after successful OTP verification. Valid for 24 hours.
JWT token for a logged-in agent. Auto-filled by the 'Agent: Login' request test script. Valid for 24 hours. Agent must be approved by admin first.
The logged-in customer's userId. Auto-filled by Verify OTP test script.
The logged-in agent's agentId. Auto-filled by Agent Login test script.
UserId of a customer resolved by an agent via ResolveCustomer. Auto-filled by ResolveCustomer test script. Use this as userId in agent bookings.
ID of a trip to book. Get this from the 'Get Tour Destination List' response. Fill this in manually before running booking requests.
ID of a created booking. Auto-filled by 'Create Booking' test script.
City ID for fetching pickup points. Default: 1 (Pune). Get real IDs from the Tour Destination List.
Transaction ID for fetching a specific transaction. Fill in after creating a booking and payment.
The OTP received on your registered mobile number via SMS. Fill this in manually before running 'Verify OTP'.
